{{Quote|The planet's greatest treasure.|The Sith Meditation Sphere Ship|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
The '''Pool of Knowledge''' was a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] located on a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. It was also located in a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]], which was reached by [[Mind Walking|separating]] one's mind from one's body. The Pool of Knowledge appeared as a dark pool in a dank grotto.

According to the [[Mind Walkers]], it offered knowledge of all of [[Time/Legends|the past and future]] if bathed in. Simply gazing upon it allowed Force visions, including the sight of the [[Throne of Balance]]. Both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] were offered the opportunity to bathe in the Pool of Knowledge, and both declined, instead merely viewing the Throne of Balance.

Later, the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] brought Skywalker and [[Ben Skywalker|his son]] there along with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Gavar Khai]] and [[Vestara Khai]]. The Pool began to show images of the Sith's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], then of a [[Allana Djo Solo|Jedi Queen]] on the Throne of Balance. Taalon demanded to know who the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]] was, as he believed that Jedi might prevent the Sith from ruling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The Skywalkers [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|attacked]] the Sith to protect the identity of the queen, who was actually their own relative, the daughter of Jacen Solo. Taalon bathed in the Pool, but the Skywalkers managed to escape from the Sith. Due to his time in the pool, Taalon began to transform into an entity like [[Abeloth]].
